questions.question: A 750 metres long train crosses a stationary pole in 15 sec. Travelling at the same speed, this train crosses a bridge completely in 25 sec. What is the length of this bridge?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of time taken = 15 : 25 = 3 : 5.

Since speed is constant, distance ratio = time ratio = 3 : 5.

Distance while crossing pole = Train length = 3 units = 750 m.

⇒ 1 unit = 250 m.

Distance while crossing bridge = (Train + Bridge) = 5 units.

Bridge length = (5 − 3) units = 2 units = 2 × 250 = 500 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 500 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of train = 750 m

Time to cross pole = 15 sec

Time to cross bridge = 25 sec

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Total distance when crossing a bridge = Length of train + Length of bridge

 
•

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of train = Length of train ÷ Time taken to cross pole

⇒ Speed = 750 ÷ 15

⇒ Speed = 50 m/sec

⇒ While crossing the bridge, Total distance = Speed × Time taken

⇒ 750 + Length of bridge = 50 × 25

⇒ 750 + Length of bridge = 1250

⇒ Length of bridge = 1250 − 750

⇒ Length of bridge = 500 m

**∴ The correct answer is 500 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Distance Rule

When a train crosses a stationary point object (pole, man), distance = Train length. For a platform or bridge, distance = Train length + Bridge length.

Relative Speed

If two trains of lengths L₁ and L₂ cross each other, total distance is always (L₁ + L₂) regardless of direction.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p

Least Common Multiple (LCM) 

**Calculation:**

Bells ring together after every 180 sec

⇒ Number of times they toll together = (1020)/(180) = 5.7 ~ 5

**∴ They toll together 5 times in 17 minutes.**

questions.question: A person sold a carpet for ₹360 and incurred a loss of 10%. At what price should it have been sold to make a gain of 20%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of the product = ₹360

Loss = 10%

**Formulae Used:**

If an article is sold at a loss of a%, then the Selling Price (SP) is:

SP = [((100 - a))/(100)] × CP

Similarly, if an article is sold at a profit of a%, then the Selling Price is:

SP = [((100 + a))/(100)] × CP

**Calculation:**

For a loss of 10%,

⇒ 360 = [((100 - 10))/(100)] × CP

⇒ 360 = 0.9 × CP

⇒ CP = (360)/(0.9) = ₹400

For a profit of 20%, the SP becomes:

⇒ SP = [((100 + 20))/(100)] × 400

⇒ SP = 1.20 × 400 = 480

**∴ The Selling Price of the article will be ₹480.**

32 men can make toys in 1 hours = (48)/(8) = 6 toys

32 men can make toys in 12 hours 12 × 6 = 72 toys.

**∴ 32 men can make 72 toys in 12 hours.**
